title: Remission Induction and Sustenance in Graves' Disease 2
brief_summary: ATD therapy for Graves' disease is one of the commonly used options for therapy of the hyperthyroidism. The investigators study how to optimally keep patients in remission.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Graves hyperthyroidism in remission after ATD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18, severe concomitant disease
